card.name: The word contest and similar
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "contest" (also "referee") when it names a competition, challenge or rivalry in general web text. A few stray hits fall partway through unrelated words.

modes.label: Contest as competition
modes.description: The word "contest" names a competition, challenge or debate, or is used as a verb meaning to dispute.
